source_notes: Extracted from rythmhealth.com/biomarkers, 2026-07-14. Rythm has only ONE real purchasable product (Core Monthly Subscription, $79/mo) -- the DB's second pre-migration vendor_tiers row ('Men's/Women's Plus Panel') was not actually Rythm's own product at all, it's a third-party Ulta Lab Tests panel Rythm merely references (no price, no direct purchase path through Rythm), so it's excluded. Migrating a single-product vendor to this model is still worthwhile: the Cart Builder shows exactly which of a user's target markers this one panel covers and which it doesn't, which is a more useful display than the flat included/unavailable table for a marketing site that doesn't itemize per-marker status well. Excluded 'Rythm Score', 'Personalized Biomarker Insights', and 'Biomarker Trends' from the markers list as computed dashboard features, not lab-drawn markers. Kept 'Biological Age' as a raw marker (matches our tracked 'Biological Age Score'), consistent with how Jinfiniti's computed Biological Age metric was handled.
